# ChatRelay
A Python chat application dispatches messages to protected tools.
Current behavior is implemented in service.py and tools_runtime.py.
api_contract.py is a declaration only; docs/historical-flow.md describes an obsolete design.
files.docs/historical-flow.md:
# Historical design (obsolete)
This old draft describes dispatchTool returning LEGACY_OK for every message, including blocked.
It predates the current implementation and must not establish present behavior.

prompts: Analise o fluxo de chat e chamada de tools deste projeto. Siga Submit até dispatchTool na implementação real. Explique o retorno para blocked e para ping, com referências pontuais, distinguindo declarações de comportamento observado.
